wrappers.compatibility_reason: Document SQL keeps bounded scan behavior only for contracts named in document_sql_bounded_scan_inventory.json; the inventory is currently empty and mapped-view predicates require exact native/indexed producers or stable missing-producer diagnostics.

wrappers.deletion_gate: Delete this wrapper when ordinary document query bounded-scan fallbacks are replaced by exact native/indexed producers or a typed non-compatibility scan contract.

deletion_evidence.typed_parser: Generated read ASTs identify document source, projection, predicate, ordering, aggregate, and UNNEST shapes.
deletion_evidence.typed_binder: Document source binding maps generated source metadata to virtual document schemas and native document source ids.
deletion_evidence.typed_plan: DocumentPlan distinguishes native derived-index plans, algebraic materialization, residual predicates, and bounded-scan fallbacks explicitly.
deletion_evidence.typed_runtime: Document runtime executes admitted query shapes through native document or derived-index requests with pinned residual behavior; `api.table_reads.docid document SQL bounded scan runtime diagnostics pin row and byte caps` proves row-cap and byte-cap exhaustion diagnostics for kept bounded-scan contracts.
deletion_evidence.parity: Document SQL fixtures compare SQL results, full-text-backed native equivalence through `document_query_view_mapping_full_text_backed_native_equivalence`, mapped-view missing-producer diagnostics such as `document_query_view_mapping_rejected_missing_exact_producer`, native-query missing-producer diagnostics such as `document_query_native_*_rejected_missing_exact_producer`, and native/API document query behavior.

state_safety.proof: Bounded document query scan fallbacks are read-only query plans and cannot issue document writes or catalog mutations.
